    "The Treasure Island (Sea Creature, Grandeur Kaine, Pirate Captain)"

    "12 gp, jewelry worth roughly 10 gp, the treasure map, a small vial of red liquid, and a conch shell",
    "40 gp, his hat, his green dragonhide loin cloth, and his magical rapier, The Rapier of Grandeur",
    "Several bottles of vintage wine, one of which appears to have been broken when the chest was first buried, three wine-stained outfits, a velvet pouch containing the bones of a large bird, a hand-sized cannon with a flint mechanism for igniting the flammable powder, an incomplete spell scroll, a note with a broken elven seal that simply reads, 'IOU', 500 gold dragons",
    "500 gold dragons",
    "The treasure chest"
  ]
}
